definitions.executions: Count raw completed episode records, including repeated cases and input comparators.
definitions.unique_cases: Within-route identifiers or serialized case contents; never sum as independent statistical samples.
definitions.unknown: Rule/nominal checks, abandoned or unlogged processes, and research/edit wall clock are outside the episode ledger.

inner_budget.unique_basis: mode/scenario/seed, valid generator; repeated IDs are not new samples
mode/scenario/seed; all three rounds reuse the same 120 identities

out_of_problem_mixture.cause: dev_evaluate calls frozen make_case unchanged; Q4 boundary/cluster/min_radius assigns a direction to every source.
out_of_problem_mixture.classification: Out-of-problem all-directional stress cases; count actual cost, do not call them valid Q4 mixed-source development evidence.

inner_budget.comparator_note: Development includes original/input-policy comparator runs. Variant names r1/r2/r3/r5/r6 mean prior candidates, not original baseline.

inner_budget.unique_basis: mode/seed; serialized case generation is deterministic; pilot and ablation reuse these IDs

ablation_budget.purpose: post-selection mechanism audit, no parameter selection

inner_budget.unique_basis: mode/seed on serialized optimized-mode cases; fixed unoptimized Q3 cases created by the script are not counted as executed

budget.excluded: Rule/geometry checks excluded. R4 original interrupted development ran additional cases with no reliable complete count; total is a recorded lower bound, not all historical calls.

A2_budget_supplement.full_quick_validation_scope: Taken from finalized execution_budget.json; parent independently verified all A2 full/quick results.
A2_budget_supplement.unlogged_interrupted_r4_development: Unknown additional count, explicitly disclosed; do not set to zero.

findings.detail: 270 recorded inner executions (135 candidate,135 baseline) use all-directional Q4 stress cases outside required mixture; no effect on frozen full validation. Revision to evidence wording needed, not retrospective data deletion.
